title: Hunts FH-044: Release seasonal versions and migration tools

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 5, Living editions. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Pin runs, maintain routes and crosswalk, support draft import from both legacy formats and old grant reads. Done when: Existing runs keep rules, imports carry no real credits and printed URLs resolve as intended. Requires: FH-013, FH-030, FH-033. Owner role: Game systems and web.
